title: Executable Reference Contract
objective: Turn Python v1 into a behavioral oracle before Rust implementation begins.

stories.title: Freeze domain vocabulary
stories.outcome: Define canonical terms for Artifact, ProviderRoot, Evidence, Confidence, Lifecycle, Authority, Plan, Action, and Result.
acceptance_criteria: Terms are defined once and reused across architecture, schemas, tests, and UI contracts.
Ambiguous legacy terms are mapped or deprecated.
verification: Documentation consistency check finds no conflicting definitions.

stories.title: Build provider layout fixture corpus
stories.outcome: Capture synthetic, privacy-safe Claude/Codex layouts for supported and adversarial cases.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover normal sessions, subagents, active data, protected state, partial trees, symlinks, and layout drift.
Fixtures contain no real user content or paths.

stories.title: Define versioned plan/result JSON contracts
stories.outcome: Specify machine-readable inventory, plan, explanation, and execution result schemas.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown fields have a documented compatibility policy.
Every destructive action carries reason, authority, reversibility, and preconditions.
verification: Golden JSON snapshots validate deterministic ordering and required fields.

stories.title: Characterize Python behavior
stories.outcome: Record Python outputs for the complete fixture corpus without treating defects as desired behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each fixture records observed output and whether it is normative, intentionally changed, or legacy-only.
verification: Golden characterization suite is reproducible on clean checkout.

stories.title: Create differential test harness contract
stories.outcome: Define how Python reference and Rust candidate outputs are normalized and compared.
acceptance_criteria: Comparison ignores only explicitly documented nondeterministic fields.
Any semantic divergence fails unless whitelisted by an accepted ADR/RFC.
verification: Harness self-test catches intentionally injected divergence.

stories.title: Freeze Python feature scope
stories.outcome: Declare Python reference maintenance-only after contract extraction.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md prohibits new product features in Python except parity/safety fixes.
Migration gate and rollback strategy are documented.
